name: Reel · How it works (glossy)
tagline: Bright glossy 9:16 explainer with word-by-word caption pill, iris transitions and a sparkle sky. Hinglish voiceover friendly.
recipe: Structure (QrReel pattern): hook question -> why -> product title -> numbered steps (Stepper) -> result -> who it is for -> product -> close/CTA.

One config.ts holds every text and timing: each scene has dur (seconds) and cues in seconds from the scene start; scene starts are the running sum. Each scene comment says where it starts in the voiceover ("// VO 3.55").
Shot wrapper per scene with Iris colour-bloom transitions at cuts (brand colours rotate), Sky backdrop with drifting sparkles, TimeCtx for scene-local time.
Captions: word-timed lines in captions.tsx built from the whisper transcript; one line at a time in a white pill, the spoken word highlighted yellow. Captions run on audio time (outside the Shots).
Headlines in DM Serif Display, body Poppins. Real standee photo / phone mockups with glossy cards, stars, taps, twinkles.
Spoken words in Hinglish stay Hinglish on screen; bracket voice directions in a script are never shown.
